input_contract.population: Adults from the UCI Parkinson's voice dataset (32 subjects, mixed diagnosed-Parkinson's and healthy controls), sustained phonation recordings. Not a prodromal or PPMI-style at-risk cohort.

temporal_validation: not applicable — cross-sectional voice recordings, no index or outcome time

calibration.note: Production-rigor nested group-aware evaluation (repeats=10, outer_repeats=5) ran 2026-08-29: balanced accuracy 0.734. This is the operational reference; the paired QML candidate failed the real-gain gate.

safety.disclaimer: Research voice-based classification estimate, not a prodromal Parkinson's risk prediction and not a diagnosis.
limitations: This is a diagnosed-Parkinson's-vs-healthy voice classifier, NOT a prodromal/at-risk progression model as the spec's P6 task (PPMI-style prodromal risk) calls for — this dataset has no prodromal or longitudinal labels.
Only 32 subjects total (147/195 recordings from Parkinson's subjects, 48/195 from healthy controls) — extremely small cohort; point-estimate metrics have very wide uncertainty.
No biomarker-supported evaluation set or approved label policy exists yet — per FR-033 this MUST remain research-only and MUST NOT be described as diagnostic.
No external cohort or site-held-out validation was possible.

model_card.intended_use: Research benchmarking of a classical gradient-boosted classifier on voice-derived features from a diagnosed-Parkinson's vs healthy cohort.
model_card.excluded_use: Any clinical use. Parkinson's disease diagnosis or prodromal risk prediction. Any use as evidence that a patient does or does not have Parkinson's disease.
model_card.training_population: 195 rows (sustained phonation voice recordings from 32 subjects: 147 recordings from Parkinson's subjects, 48 from healthy controls), with repeated measurements per subject. 147 positive (75.4%, Parkinson's status = 1).
model_card.evaluation_population: Stratified group-based holdout (by subject) of the same UCI table. No external cohort.
model_card.label_policy: Binary 'status' column as supplied, positive_label='1' (Parkinson's diagnosis). Derived from subject-level clinical diagnosis, not longitudinal progression.

data_sources.label: UCI Parkinson's voice dataset (via Kaggle elnazalikarami/uci-ml-parkinsons-dataset)
data_sources.citation: Little, M.A. et al. Suitability of dysphonia measurements for telemonitoring of Parkinson's disease. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng, 2009.

data_licenses: CC BY 4.0 — verified, permissive with attribution
model_card.explanation_method: input_sensitivity over the 4 ANOVA-selected raw features

reuse_manifest.license: in-repo, license field not yet declared
reuse_manifest.preprocessing_assumptions: numeric CSV columns, or text columns auto one-hot encoded
one row per voice recording (195 recordings from 32 subjects); group-based split prevents same-subject leakage
reuse_manifest.io_contract: 24-column CSV (22 voice features + status + subject); subject column used for group-based train-test split
